episodes.synopsis: A group of pirates lead by Alvida plunder a ship, only to find a barrel which contains a strange boy named Luffy. Luffy is on a mission to find the legendary treasure "One Piece" and he befriends the ship's cabin-boy, Coby, who actually wants to become a marine officer. Luffy defeats Alvida and the two journey on in search of crewmates.
episodes.title: I'm Luffy! The Man Who Will Become the Pirate King!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy and Coby arrive at Shell Island, a Marine base. They meet the bounty hunter Roronoa Zoro, held under arrest by the infamous marine, Captain Morgan, and his son Helmeppo.
episodes.title: The Great Swordsman Appears! Pirate Hunter, Roronoa Zoro

episodes.synopsis: Luffy convinces Zoro to join his crew, but they must first defeat Captain Morgan. After freeing the island from Morgan's oppressive rule, Coby is accepted as a marine while the other two continue on their journey.
episodes.title: Morgan VS Luffy! Who's This Beautiful Young Girl?

episodes.synopsis: Out on the sea, Luffy almost loses his hat and reflects on his past, and how a pirate named Shanks influenced him. Afterwards, Luffy meets Nami, and Buggy the Clown's men.
episodes.title: Luffy's Past! The Red-haired Shanks appears

episodes.synopsis: In order to save herself and steal a map to the Grand Line, Nami tricks Luffy into allowing her to turn him over to Buggy.
episodes.title: Fear, Mysterious Power! Pirate Clown Captain Buggy!

episodes.synopsis: Mohji and Richie show up for revenge after Buggy's humiliating defeat in the previous episode, and Luffy meets a small dog guarding his master's store, even though he knows that he is long dead.
episodes.title: Desperate Situation! Beast Tamer Mohji vs Luffy!

episodes.synopsis: Enraged by the actions of Buggy's crew, the city's mayor rushes to fight Buggy himself, but the Straw Hat Pirates come to his rescue. Zoro fights Cabaji, despite still being wounded from his previous encounter with Buggy, while Luffy faces the clown pirate himself and Nami searches for the map to the Grand Line.
episodes.title: Grand Duel! Zoro the Swordsman vs Cabaji the Acrobat!

episodes.synopsis: Buggy's link to Shanks is revealed, and when he rips the straw hat Shanks gave Luffy, his rage knows no bounds. Who will win in this clash between Devil Fruit users?
episodes.title: Who Will Win? Showdown Between the True Powers of the Devil!

episodes.synopsis: Nami form an alliance becoming the navigator of the crew, but not a full member yet. They arrive in Syrup Village looking for a suitable ship. On this island they know the liar Usopp, who also has ties to the Shanx.
episodes.title: The Honorable Liar? Captain Usopp!

episodes.synopsis: When trying to convince his rich friend, Kaya, to give the Straw Hats a ship, Usopp is told to stay away from her by her caretaker, Klahadore. However, when Usopp and Luffy later see him conversing with a strange man, they learn of a plot to kill Kaya.
episodes.title: The Weirdest Guy Ever! Jango the Hypnotist!

episodes.synopsis: After learning of Captain Kuro's evil plan, Usopp runs back to the village to warn Kaya, only to find that after all his years of lying no one believes him.
episodes.title: Expose the Plot! Pirate Butler, Captain Kuro!

episodes.synopsis: Usopp resolves to keep his story of pirates attacking the town a lie by making sure none reach it. Luffy, Zoro, Nami, and Usopp then try to keep the Black Cat Pirates at bay.
episodes.title: Clash with the Black Cat Pirates! The Great Battle on the Slope!

episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats manage to take out most of the opposing Black Cat Pirates, so Jango orders the Nyaban Brothers to attack. Meanwhile, after getting hypnotized by Jango, Luffy gets himself stuck under the collapsed mast of the Black Cat Pirates' ship.
episodes.title: The Terrifying Duo! Meowban Brothers vs. Zoro!

episodes.synopsis: Captain Kuro himself arrives at the scene, and with Zoro too injured to fight, Luffy being incapacitated, and the other two being too weak to handle him, things seem hopeless. However, Kaya herself appears to bargain with Kuro.
episodes.title: Luffy Back in Action! Miss Kaya's Desperate Resistance!

episodes.synopsis: Zoro and Buchi (of the Nyaban Brothers) face off once again as Luffy and Kuro begin their fight. Usopp orders the Usopp Pirates to run away with Kaya, but Jango goes after them. A flashback reveals how Captain Kuro faked his death with Captain Morgan and how he became Kaya's butler.
episodes.title: Beat Kuro! Usopp the Man's Tearful Resolve!

episodes.synopsis: As the fight between Luffy and Kuro is close to an end, the Usopp Pirates do their best to avoid Jango.
episodes.title: Protect Kaya! The Usopp Pirates' Great Efforts!

episodes.synopsis: Kuro's ultimate attack, "Shakushi", attacks everything in the area, whether friend or foe, and Luffy becomes enraged by his lack of regard for his crew. Will Luffy's determination overcome Kuro's sheer speed?
episodes.title: Anger Explosion! Kuro vs. Luffy! How it Ends!

episodes.synopsis: With Usopp now in the crew and a new ship, the Going Merry, under their command, the Straw Hats head to an island said to hold a fabled treasure, only to encounter a strange man stuck in a treasure box that has also been looking for this treasure.
episodes.title: You're the Weird Creature! Gaimon and His Strange Friends!

episodes.synopsis: While Usopp & Luffy fool around with the ship's cannon one day, Zoro dreams about his childhood and the promise he made to Kuina.
episodes.title: The Three-Sword Style's Past! Zoro and Kuina's Vow!

episodes.synopsis: The crew meets Johnny and Yosaku, Zoro's former companions, and they set sail for the Baratie restaurant in search of a cook.
episodes.title: Famous Cook! Sanji of the Sea Restaurant!

episodes.synopsis: Sanji, a cook at the Baratie, helps a starving pirate named Gin. Luffy begins his job as a waiter to pay for the damage he did to the Baratie, and tries to convince Sanji to join his crew.
episodes.title: Unwelcome Customer! Sanji's Food and Ghin's Debt!

episodes.synopsis: Gin returns to the Baratie with his also-starving captain, Don Krieg, to whom Sanji once more gives food, but Don Krieg betrays the cook once he regains his energy.
episodes.title: The Strongest Pirate Fleet! Commodore Don Krieg!

episodes.synopsis: It is revealed that Chef Zeff was a great pirate known as Red Leg Zeff. Gin explains the catastrophe the fleet met in Grand Line when they encountered Hawk-Eyes Mihawk, and Krieg attempts to take control of the Baratie.
episodes.title: Protect Baratie! The Great Pirate, Red Foot Zeff!

episodes.synopsis: As Nami steals the Going Merry, Mihawk has returned to finish the job, but Zoro challenges him to a duel in order to achieve his dream.
episodes.title: Hawk-Eye Mihawk! The Great Swordsman Zoro Falls At Sea!

episodes.synopsis: Mihawk leaves after defeating Zoro, so Krieg continues his invasion and has Pearl, one of his stronger crewmates, attack, and Sanji reveals his fighting skills. Meanwhile Johnny and Yosaku leave with Usopp and the wounded Zoro to go after Nami.
episodes.title: The Deadly Foot Technique Bursts Forth! Sanji vs. The Invincible Pearl!

episodes.synopsis: With Zeff held captive by Gin, Sanji has no choice but to take Pearl's hits, and he reflects on why Zeff means so much to him.
episodes.title: Zeff and Sanji's Dream! The Illusory All Blue!

episodes.synopsis: Gin finishes off Pearl, claiming that he wants to kill Sanji himself. Still wounded, Sanji faces Gin while Luffy attacks Don Krieg.
episodes.title: Cool-headed, Cold-hearted Demon! Pirate Fleet Chief Commander Ghin!

episodes.synopsis: When Gin refuses to kill Sanji, Krieg uses a poison gas on him. Luffy seems to have the advantage in the fight until Krieg pulls out his explosive Battle Spear.
episodes.title: I Won't Die! Fierce Battle, Luffy vs. Krieg!

episodes.synopsis: Even after taking several hits from the Battle Spear, Luffy refuses to give up.
episodes.title: The Conclusion of the Deadly Battle! A Spear of Blind Determination!

episodes.synopsis: After the battle, Gin decides to go back to the Grand Line with Krieg despite still being poisoned, and Sanji makes the difficult decision on whether to stay or to go with Luffy just as Yosaku comes back with news that he knows where Nami is.
episodes.title: Set Sail! The Seafaring Cook Sets Off With Luffy!

episodes.synopsis: The crew chases after Nami, who stole their ship, and Yosaku takes time during the trip to explain about Arlong and his Fishmen to Luffy and Sanji. Meanwhile, Usopp, Johnny, and Zoro arrive at the island Nami docked at.
episodes.title: The Worst Man in the Eastern Seas! Fishman Pirate Arlong!

episodes.synopsis: Zoro is captured by the fishmen after Usopp and Johnny ditch him, and it's revealed that Nami was part of Arlong's crew the entire time. When a group of Fishmen attack Cocoyashi Village, Usopp comes to the rescue.
episodes.title: Witch of Cocoyashi Village! Arlong's Female Leader!

episodes.synopsis: After Zoro escapes with Nami's help, she tries to prove her loyalty to the Arlong Pirates by appearing to kill Usopp. Meanwhile, Luffy's group finally arrives at the island.
episodes.title: Usopp Dead?! When is Luffy Going to Make Landfall?!

episodes.synopsis: Johnny tells the others about Nami killing Usopp, and Luffy does not believe them until Nami appears herself and confirms it. She tells them to stay out of her business and leave without her, but Luffy stubbornly decides to stay on the island. Usopp returns, revealing that Nami only pretended to kill him, and Nami's sister, Nojiko, starts to explain why Nami is acting the way she is.
episodes.title: Everyone's Gathered! Usopp Speaks the Truth About Nami!

episodes.synopsis: Nojiko starts her story about Nami's childhood and their adopted mother, Bellemere. Despite being poor and none of them being related by blood, they had a happy life.
episodes.title: Untold Past! Female Warrior Bellemere!

episodes.synopsis: Nojiko continues her story, explaining how their life was ruined when the Arlong Pirates first took over the village.
episodes.title: Survive! Mother Bellemere and Nami's Bond!

episodes.synopsis: When a marine officer under Arlong's pay confiscates all the money Nami stole over the years, in order to one day buy the village from Arlong, the villagers decide that enough is enough and fight back, despite Nami's pleads that they do not and that they'd all be killed. Upon seeing Nami's sorrow, the Straw Hats head for Arlong Park.
episodes.title: Luffy Rises! Result of the Broken Promise!

episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats face the Fishmen themselves as the villagers watch from the sidelines.
episodes.title: Luffy in Big Trouble! Fishmen vs. The Luffy Pirates!

episodes.synopsis: Arlong has trapped Luffy in the ocean and Zoro faces the six-sword wielding octopus Hatchan.
episodes.title: Luffy Submerged! Zoro vs. Hatchan the Octopus!

episodes.synopsis: With Hatchan defeated, two of the fishmen battle Sanji and Usopp. Things look grim for Sanji as he attempts to face Kuroobi underwater, and Usopp gets the chance to prove that he too is a brave warrior.
episodes.title: Proud Warriors! Sanji and Usopp's Fierce Battles!

episodes.synopsis: Arlong's officers have been defeated, but Sanji and Zoro prove to be no match for Arlong in their current state. However, with Luffy finally free, he just may be able to defeat the "most wicked man in the East Blue". Meanwhile, Nami finally gathers the courage to face Arlong.
episodes.title: Luffy at Full Power! Nami's Determination and the Straw Hat!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy returns to the fight, and the battle with Arlong versus Luffy begins.
episodes.title: Explosion! Fishman Arlong's Fierce Assault From the Sea!

episodes.synopsis: The battle spreads into Arlong Park itself and Arlong is no longer holding back.
episodes.title: End of the Fishman Empire! Nami's My Friend!

episodes.synopsis: Arlong's reign of terror is over, and no one has anything on their mind except to party. As the crew celebrates, Nami reflects on her hometown and decides to officially join the Straw Hat Pirates.
episodes.title: Setting Out with a Smile! Farewell, Hometown Cocoyashi Village!

episodes.synopsis: As a result of defeating Buggy, Krieg and Arlong, Luffy now has the highest bounty in all of East Blue. News quickly spreads to Shanks, who celebrates Luffy's arrival into the world of pirates by partying with Mihawk, despite already being severely hungover.
episodes.title: Bounty! Straw Hat Luffy Becomes Known to the World!

episodes.synopsis: After his fight with Luffy, Buggy was sent flying to another island with several body parts missing. Thus, Buggy begins his journey to find his crew and his body parts, making some unlikely friends.
episodes.title: Chase Straw Hat! Little Buggy's Big Adventure!

episodes.synopsis: With Buggy assumed to be dead, his crew fights over who will be the new captain, only to be captured by a tribe of cannibals.
episodes.title: The Wait is Over! The Return of Captain Buggy!

episodes.synopsis: The crew arrives at the last large town before the entrance to the Grand Line--Loguetown, the place where Gold Roger was both born and executed, where they stock up on supplies and sightsee. As Luffy heads for the execution platform where Roger was killed, old enemies are searching for him.
episodes.title: The Town of the Beginning and the End! Landfall at Logue Town!

episodes.synopsis: While searching for new swords to replace the ones shattered by Mihawk, Zoro meets a woman named Tashigi, who looks exactly like an older Kuina, who then helps him look.
episodes.title: Zoro's New Swords and the Woman Sergeant Major!

episodes.synopsis: Usopp manages to anger the daughter of bounty hunter Daddy the Father, and finds his own life at stake. When Daddy discovers that Usopp is the son of Yasopp, the only man to beat him, he challenges him to a duel.
episodes.title: Usopp vs. Daddy the Parent! Showdown at High!

episodes.synopsis: In order to win a rare fish, Sanji enters a cooking contest and faces a woman named Carmen.
episodes.title: Fiery Cooking Battle? Sanji vs. The Beautiful Chef!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy arrives at the execution platform only to be caught in a trap by Buggy and Alvida.
episodes.title: Buggy's Revenge! The Man Who Smiles On the Execution Platform!

episodes.synopsis: Miraculously saved from death by an unnatural green gust and a lightning bolt to Buggy, the Straw Hats rush out of Loguetown, only for Zoro to be stopped by Tashigi and Luffy to be stopped by Captain Smoker.
episodes.title: The Legend Has Started! Head for the Grand Line!

episodes.synopsis: On a stormy night a girl called Apis escapes from the Marines and arrives at Straw hat's ship, but the girl upon knowing that they are pirates begins to hide some of the reasons which she is being wanted by the Marines. As the Straw Hats escape from the Marines, they get caught in the Calm Belt.
episodes.title: Precursor to a New Adventure! Apis, a Mysterious Girl!

episodes.synopsis: After escaping the clutches of the Marine fleet, the Straw Hats soon find themselves in an equally dangerous predicament - stranded in the Calm Belt!
episodes.title: Miraculous Creature! Apis's Secret and The Legendary Island!

episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats want to return Apis's dragon to his nest, but the Marines have them surrounded. Looks like it's time for another daring escape!
episodes.title: Eric Attacks! Great Escape From Warship Island!

episodes.synopsis: Even for Nami, finding the dragon's lost island proves to be tougher than looking for a needle in a haystack - or at the bottom of the ocean.
episodes.title: A Solitary Island in the Distant Sea! The Legendary Lost Island!

episodes.synopsis: Zoro is left fighting with Eric while Luffy and the gang run to the ship in order to get to Lost Island, but only find more problems.
episodes.title: Showdown in the Ruins! Tense Zoro vs. Eric!

episodes.synopsis: At last Admiral Nelson has seen through the ambitions of Eric, but takes it a little too personally and now the mystical dragon's life is in danger.
episodes.title: Luffy, Completely Surrounded! Commodore Nelson's Secret Strategy!

episodes.synopsis: With his last breath, Ryuuji calls all his fellow dragons, and the Lost Island re-surfaced. Meanwhile Luffy takes out Admiral Nelson and his gang.
episodes.title: Through the Sky They Soar! The 1000 Year Legend Lives Again!

episodes.synopsis: After leaving Warship Island the Going Merry is now towards the Grand Line, and the crew now returns to the Great Adventure.
episodes.title: An Angry Showdown! Cross the Red Line!

episodes.synopsis: Upon entering the Grand Line, the ship is swallowed by a giant whale, inside of which they discover a strange place. In addition, they are not the only ones there.
episodes.title: The First Line of Defense? The Giant Whale Laboon Appears!

episodes.synopsis: After hearing the story of Laboon the whale, Luffy comes up with a clever solution to his problems. From Laboon's caretaker, Crocus, the crew learns more about the Grand Line and how to navigate through it, since compasses are useless there.
episodes.title: A Promise Between Men! Luffy and the Whale Vow to Meet Again!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy and friends arrive at Whisky Peak, a town of pirate-lovers who hold them a feast.
episodes.title: A Town that Welcomes Pirates? Setting Foot on Whisky Peak!

episodes.synopsis: Zoro battles a hundred members of Baroque Works, and discovers there is more to them than meets the eye.
episodes.title: Explosion! The Three Swords Style! Zoro vs. Baroque Works!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy, who does not realize the town is full of bounty hunters, engages in a battle with Zoro after he discovers that Zoro attacked the townsfolk, while Mr. 5 and Miss Valentine head for Princess Vivi.
episodes.title: All Out Battle! Luffy vs. Zoro, Mysterious Grand Duel!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy's crew manages to become targets of Crocodile, one of the Shichibukai, and decide to help Princess Vivi. They also meet Miss All-Sunday, the second strongest member of Baroque Works and partner of Crocodile.
episodes.title: Deliver Princess Vivi! The Luffy Pirates Set Sail!

episodes.synopsis: As Luffy and his crew are sailing in the Grand Line, Koby and Helmeppo are stuck doing odd-jobs for the marines back in East Blue, and encounter Vice-Admiral Garp.
episodes.title: Try Hard, Coby! Coby and Helmeppo's Struggles in the Marines!

episodes.synopsis: Vice Admiral Garp mentors Koby and Helmeppo to become marines.
episodes.title: Coby and Helmeppo's Resolve! Vice-Admiral Garp's Parental Affection!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy and friends land on Little Garden, a prehistoric island inhabited by dinosaurs and giants.
episodes.title: An Ancient Island! The Shadow Hiding in Little Garden!

episodes.synopsis: Nami and Usopp meet a giant named Brogy, while Luffy and Vivi encounter Brogy's rival, Dorry. The Straw Hats little suspect that Officer Agents of Baroque Works are on their tail.
episodes.title: Huge Duel! The Giants Dorry and Broggy!

episodes.synopsis: Dorry, critically injured by exploding ale, blames the Straw Hats. Luffy is enraged that someone would pull such a cowardly trick to sabotage the giants' honorable duel.
episodes.title: Luffy Gets Angry! A Dirty Trick Violates the Sacred Duel!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy tries in vain to convince the injured Dorry not to fight Brogy. The Officer Agents who sabotaged Dorry's ale further tamper with the giants' duel.
episodes.title: Broggy's Bitter Tears of Victory! The Conclusion of Elbaf!

episodes.synopsis: Having subdued the giants, Baroque Works makes their move. Mr. 3 introduces Zoro, Nami, Vivi, and Brogy to the slow torture of becoming living statues of wax.
episodes.title: The Devilish Candle! Tears of Regret and Tears of Anger!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy attempts to rescue his friends but only accelerates the deadly waxing process. To make matters worse, Miss Goldenweek interferes and reveals her own terrifying ability.
episodes.title: A Hex on Luffy! Colors Trap!

episodes.synopsis: Usopp frees Luffy from Miss Goldenweek's control. With Karoo's help, Usopp and Luffy rescue the others, who take on Mr. 5 and Miss Valentine. Luffy and Karoo pursue Mr. 3 and Miss Goldenweek into the forest.
episodes.title: Time to Fight Back! Usopp’s Quick Thinking and Fire Star!

episodes.synopsis: After having a pleasant chat with Mr. 0 and encountering the "Unluckies", Sanji retrieves an Eternal Pose for Alabasta. The crew leaves Little Garden and sets sail for Alabasta.
episodes.title: Farewell Giant Island! Head for Alabasta!

episodes.synopsis: Nami is sick, but the crew doesn't have a doctor to help her.
episodes.title: Nami's Sick? Beyond the Snow Falling on the Sea!

episodes.synopsis: While looking for a doctor, the crew meets the pirate Wapol, who attacks them, but only makes Luffy send him flying. Meanwhile Smoker manages to intercept the conversation between Mr. 0 and Sanji and plans to go to Alabasta. Back with the crew they arrive at last to an island only to find out they're not welcome.
episodes.title: A Raid! The Tin Tyrant and Tin Plate Wapol!

episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hat crew manages to gain the trust of the people that attacked them, and are taken to the village, except for Zoro and Carue, who guard the ship. Luffy and Sanji must take Nami to the island's sole doctor who lives on a mountain-top. Vivi and Usopp discover the past of the island, and about the pirate Wapol from Dalton.
episodes.title: An Island without Doctors? Adventure in a Nameless Land!

episodes.synopsis: While Sanji and Luffy fight off the wilderness, the islander's worst nightmare turns true, as Wapol returns to the island. The doctor is discovered to be on the other side of the island, and Usopp, Vivi and Dalton rush to find her. Dalton however returns as he hears of Wapol's return.
episodes.title: Are You Happy? The Doctor Called Witch!

episodes.synopsis: Dalton faces Wapol, but only gets himself hit by arrows thrown by his former comrade Chess. An avalanche stops the battle, but injures Sanji. Luffy must carry both Nami and Sanji to the doctor, and begins his ascent.
episodes.title: Dalton's Resolve! Wapol's Corps Lands on the Island!

episodes.synopsis: The Lapahn help Luffy escape from Wapol, giving him enough time to climb to the castle where doctor Kureha lives. Vivi, Usopp and Zoro deal with the king's army in order to save Dalton. The recovering Nami meets a strange creature.
episodes.title: The Island Where Snow Lives! Climb the Drum Rockies!

episodes.synopsis: Nami asks Chopper to join the crew, but he isn't interested. Kureha tells Nami some of what was Chopper's background. After realizing the abilities that Chopper has, Luffy is eager to make him join the crew.
episodes.title: Blue-nosed Reindeer! Chopper's Secret!

episodes.synopsis: Doctorine continues to tell how Chopper lived his life and how the quack doctor Hiruluk took care of him.
episodes.title: An Outcast's Dream! Hiriluk the Quack!

episodes.synopsis: More of Chopper's past is revealed, including the fate of doctor Hiruluk and Wapol's cruelties as the king. Meanwhile, Wapol reaches the castle where the crew is residing.
episodes.title: Hiriluk's Cherry Blossoms and the Will that Gets Carried On!

episodes.synopsis: Wapol is determined to bring down Hiruluk's flag, and to do that, he engages Sanji, Luffy and Chopper in a fight.
episodes.title: Fight Wapol's Crew! The Power of the Munch Munch Fruit!

episodes.synopsis: Chopper demonstrates the abilities of Rumble Balls when fighting Chessmarimo. Dalton is uncovered from the avalanche.
episodes.title: Zoan-type Devil Fruit! Chopper's Seven-form Transformation!

episodes.synopsis: After trying every trick in the castle, Wapol is finally hunted down by Luffy. The villagers along with Zoro, Vivi and Usopp start their ascent to the castle through a ropeway.
episodes.title: When the Kingdom's Rule Ends! The Flag of Faith Flies Forever!

episodes.synopsis: After finally been convinced to join the team, Chopper announces his intentions to Dr. Kureha, who doesn't take it too well; but after escaping from the castle, she has decided to give the whole Straw Hat crew a farewell gift.
episodes.title: Hiriluk's Cherry Blossoms! Miracle in the Drum Rockies!

episodes.synopsis: Chopper joins the Straw Hat crew as they continue their journey to Vivi's homeland.
episodes.title: Goodbye Drum Island! I'm Going Out to Sea!

episodes.synopsis: Crocodile appears to stop rampaging pirates. Luffy and his crew meet Mr.  2 Bon Clay who shows off his devil fruit power and Vivi sees a shocking  sight.
episodes.title: Alabasta's Hero and a Ballerina on the Ship!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy separates from the rest of the crew, right after arriving at  Alabasta's port city of Nanohana. The crew dons disguises while Luffy  learns of Dance Powder.
episodes.title: Off to the Desert Kingdom! The Rain-Summing Powder and the Rebel Army!

episodes.synopsis: While in Nanohana, the Straw Hats encounter Smoker and Tashigi. A powerful pirate named Portgas D. Ace appears.
episodes.title: The Heroes Reunion! His Name is Fire Fist Ace!

episodes.synopsis: Ace fights Smoker while the Straw Hats run for their ship. Luffy  reunites with his brother, who has joined the Whitebeard Pirates after  leaving home, and is searching for a former crewmate named Blackbeard  who killed a fellow member.
episodes.title: Ace and Luffy! Hot Emotions and Brotherly Bonds!

episodes.synopsis: Ace decides to travel with the Straw Hats, as he is hunting for a man known as Blackbeard.
episodes.title: Erumalu, The City of Green and the Kung Fu Dugongs!!

episodes.synopsis: After leaving Erumalu, the Straw Hats plus Vivi & Ace continue through the desert, facing the many dangers of it.
episodes.title: Adventure in the Country of Sand! The Monsters that Live in the Scorching Land!

episodes.synopsis: Nami and Vivi found themselves an easier way to travel in the desert and leave all men behind.
episodes.title: Enter the Desert Pirates! The Men Who Live Freely!

episodes.synopsis: After hearing that a small village has fake Rebel Army bodyguards that  have been keeping peace, Vivi asks the men of the crew to test if  they're worthy of staying.
episodes.title: False Fortitude! Camu, Rebel Soldier at Heart!

episodes.synopsis: Still trekking through the Alabasta desert, the crew beats up a giant  desert scorpion for lunch, while Vivi tells Nami about her past and her  friendship with Kohza.
episodes.title: Rebel Warrior Koza! The Dream Vowed to Vivi!

episodes.synopsis: Ace fights against a bounty hunter, who claims to have defeated  Blackbeard, although this was a lie to lure Ace out and challenge him in  order to inspire his children to follow their dreams.
episodes.title: Showdown in a Heat Haze! Ace vs. the Gallant Scorpion!

episodes.synopsis: Zoro, Chopper and Luffy manage to get themselves lost and stumble across some huge underground ruins.
episodes.title: Ruins and Lost Ways! Vivi, Her Friends, and the Country's Form!

episodes.synopsis: Baroque Works plan starts to take effect, and for that, the Number Agents gather to meet Mr. 0. Meanwhile, the crew finds out that the Rebel Army has moved out of Yuba and headed to Katorea, and the rebel leader Kohza is determined to attack.
episodes.title: Spiders Café at 8 o'Clock! The Enemy Leaders Gather!

episodes.synopsis: In Yuba, Luffy learns that Toto was entrusted by Cobra to watch over the land and figures out a way to stop the sandstorm.
episodes.title: Luffy vs. Vivi! The Tearful Vow to Put Friends on the Line!

episodes.synopsis: After the struggle, Vivi decides to go after Crocodile with the Straw  Hats. The crew travels to the city of Rainbase, but run afoul of Smoker  and Tashigi.
episodes.title: The Battlefront of Alabasta! Rainbase, the City of Dreams!

episodes.synopsis: Most of the Straw Hats, along with Smoker, are trapped by Crocodile.  Vivi reunites with the royal guardian Pell, but is captured by Miss  All-Sunday. Crocodile reveals his invincible Devil Fruit power.
episodes.title: The Trap of Certain Defeat! Storming Raindinners!

episodes.synopsis: Baroque Works' plan to take over Alabasta is set in motion.
episodes.title: Operation Utopia Commences! The Swell of Rebellion Stirs!

episodes.synopsis: Most of the Straw Hats are helplessly trapped as Vivi tries desperately  to get the key to their cage. but fails. Crocodile is contacted by  someone known as "Mr. Prince."
episodes.title: The Terrifying Banana Gators and Mr. Prince!

episodes.synopsis: The identity of "Mr. Prince" is revealed.
episodes.title: The Key to a Great Comeback Escape! The Wax-Wax Ball!

episodes.synopsis: After escaping from Rain Dinners, the Straw Hats and Vivi cross the desert to Alubarne, where the final battle will take place.
episodes.title: Merciless Mortal Combat! Luffy vs. Crocodile!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy is left for dead by Crocodile, but is helped by the mysteríous  Miss All-Sunday. The rest of the Straw Hats reach Alubarna.
episodes.title: Dash For a Miracle! Alabasta Animal Land!

episodes.synopsis: The revolution is on the verge of starting and the crew comes out with a plan that could stop it.
episodes.title: Rebel Army vs. Royal Army! Showdown at Alubarna!

episodes.synopsis: Vivi tries to call out to the Rebel Army, but fails because of a Baroque Works infiltrator in the Royal Army interferes.
episodes.title: Alubarna Grieves! The Fierce Captain Karoo!

episodes.synopsis: Things look hopeless for Usopp & Chopper as they continue to suffer from every attack that the Mr.4 team makes. However, the tides may be beginning to turn as Usopp learns what it truly means to be a man.
episodes.title: Sworn on a Friend's Dream! The Battle of Molehill, Block 4!

episodes.synopsis: Albeit severely beaten and bruised, Usopp and Chopper have finally defeated the Mr.4 team. However, Mr. 2 has figured out Sanji's weakness.
episodes.title: Big Opening Day Today! The Copy-Copy Montage!

episodes.synopsis: Though Mr. 2 discovers Sanji's weakness, Sanji still defeats his opponent after an evenly-matched fight. Meanwhile, before Vivi could give the word to blow up the palace, Crocodile appears.
episodes.title: Transformed into Nami! Bon Clay's Rapid-Fire Ballet Kenpo!

episodes.synopsis: Nami faces off against Miss Doublefinger and tries to figure out her new weapon that Usopp made, the Clima-Tact.
episodes.title: Nami's Cyclone Advisory! Clima Takt Burst!

episodes.synopsis: While Crocodile reveals to Vivi about the ancient weapon Pluton, Nami attempts to defeat Miss Doublefinger with her most powerful attack: The Tornado Tempo.
episodes.title: Secret Passed Down in the Royal Family! The Ancient Weapon Pluton!

episodes.synopsis: While Miss. Doublefinger's fight with Nami was challenging, Zoro is having an even more difficult time fighting Mr.1: A man who can change his entire body into steel - something that Zoro cannot cut. As Zoro nears death, he must discover the secret to "the breath of all things".
episodes.title: Secret of Powerful Swordplay! Ability to Cut Steel and the Rhythm Things Have!

episodes.synopsis: When Vivi reveals Crocodile's plan to Koza, he attempts to stop the fighting, but is shot. Crocodile reveals that he has set up a massive bomb in the city.
episodes.title: The Battle is Over! Koza Raises the White Flag!

episodes.synopsis: As Koza tries to stop the Rebel Army, both sides are once more fighting due to the intervention of Baroque Works. Vivi is thrown to her certain death when Luffy saves her and challenges Crocodile to a second round.
episodes.title: Where Vivi's Voice Gets Heard! The Hero Descends!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy fights Crocodile with more success this time by using water, but still loses this round. Meanwhile, the other Straw Hats hurry to locate the bomb before it goes off. Nico Robin forces the king to take her to the tomb where the Pluton Poneglyph is hidden.
episodes.title: Sand Croc and Water Luffy! The Second Round of the Duel

episodes.synopsis: Crocodile joins Robin in the tomb, and orders her to translate the Poneglyph. Robin tells him that Pluton was not mentioned and that it was only about history, but Crocodile figures out that she was lying and stabs her in response. When Luffy recovers from the last round of fighting, he chases after Crocodile into the tomb.
episodes.title: That Looks Croc-ish! Luffy, Run to the Royal Tomb!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy fights with Crocodile by using blood on his fists. Meanwhile Vivi finds the bomb, and calls the Straw Hats together.
episodes.title: The Nightmare Draws Near! This is the Sand-Sand Clan's Secret Base!

episodes.synopsis: Vivi finds the bomb inside of the clock tower, but the Mr. 7 pair of Baroque Works are there to protect it. Vivi defeats them, but she realizes the bomb cannot be stopped so easily. It has a timer, and right before it blows up, Pell shows up and takes it into the atmosphere, where he sacrifices himself to save Alabasta.
episodes.title: Magnificent Wings! My Name is Pell, Guardian Deity of the Country!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy defeats Crocodile by punching him through solid bedrock. When Crocodile falls, the rain-drops calm the soldiers.
episodes.title: I Will Surpass You! Rain Falls in Alabasta!

episodes.synopsis: Now that the battle has ended, the outcome is tallied. Igaram appears with proof of Cobra's innocence, as well as Koza telling everything. Tashigi and Smoker both are rewarded for taking on Crocodile, but neither one of them believes that is right, considering the Straw Hat pirates did all the work.
episodes.title: A Farewell to Arms! Pirates and Different Ideas of Justice!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy is rescued from the collapsed tomb where he fought Crocodile and brought into Cobra's palace to rest. When he awakens, a magnificent banquet is thrown for the pirates, then, the Straw Hats are invited to enjoy the hot spring steam room inside the palace.
episodes.title: The Pirates' Banquet and Operation Escape from Alabasta!

episodes.synopsis: It's the day for Vivi's speech and her decision whether or not to continue to be with the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Bon Kurei and his crew attempt to protect the Straw Hats from Hina.
episodes.title: It All Started On That Day! Vivi Tells the Story of Her Adventure!

episodes.synopsis: The Marines fail again to catch the Straw Hats. After escaping from Marines, Nico Robin (Ms. All Sunday) appears from inside of Straw Hats ship. She manages to persuade the crew to let her join. Pell is seen at the end standing over his own grave.
episodes.title: Scent of Danger! The Seventh Member is Nico Robin!

episodes.synopsis: After their adventures in Alabasta, the crew come upon another deserted island and split up tasks amongst themselves. Chopper is left in charge of guarding the ship, and he reminisces about the day he first made the rumble ball and his first patient, Dr. Kureha, while spending some time with the newest crewmember: Nico Robin.
episodes.title: The First Patient! The Untold Story of the Rumble Ball!

episodes.synopsis: A weird salesman is fished out of the water and onto the Going Merry, and Nami buys a ton of "1000 year paper" from him to draw her sea maps. However, that's not going to be easy with the rest of the crew goofing off as usual.
episodes.title: Uprising of the Navigator! For the Unyielding Dream!

episodes.synopsis: The Going Merry runs into several Marine ships in some fog, and the Straw Hats meet a trainee Marine chef named Tajiyo. Sanji helps him out of a bit of cooking trouble.
episodes.title: A Recipe Handed Down! Sanji, the Iron Man of Curry!

episodes.synopsis: The crew stops on an island that's having its annual fireworks festival; Usopp meets a young fireworks-maker named Kodama and helps her achieve her dream.
episodes.title: I Will Make it Bloom! Usopp, the Man, and the Eight-Foot Shell!

episodes.synopsis: Zoro has a flashback about the time when he first met Johnny and Yosaku, and faced off against Bandits and, Dick.
episodes.title: The Fabled Pirate Hunter! Zoro, the Wandering Swordsman!

episodes.synopsis: After escaping from several Marine ships, the Straw Hats land on an uncharted island and meet an old man named Zenny. Chopper finds out that, because of his bad heart, Zenny probably only has three days to live.
episodes.title: Zenny of the Island of Goats and the Pirate Ship in the Mountains!

episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats help Zenny out, hoping to make his last days good ones; they learn about Zenny's past as a money lender, and his dream of becoming a pirate. But Zoro realizes that Zenny has outlived Chopper's predictions and so the straw hats decide that, after helping him finish his pirate ship, they will leave the island.
episodes.title: How's Tricks? The Designs of Zenny the Moneylender!

episodes.synopsis: Zenny decides to follow his dream and become a pirate, despite his age. He helps the Straw Hats out of trouble with the Marines, and then they part ways.
episodes.title: Whereabouts of the Island Treasure! Attack of the Zenny Pirates!

episodes.synopsis: On Ruluka Island, some of the Straw Hats make enemies of the Mayor and his men, who have placed high taxes on everything. Robin, Usopp, and Luffy meet Professor Henzo, who's doing research on the island's rainbow mist. When some of the mist shows up, Henzo borrows the Going Merry to go explore it.
episodes.title: Legend of the Rainbow Mist! Old Man Henzo of Luluka Island!

episodes.synopsis: The inside of the Rainbow Mist full of wrecked ships and treasure, and is guarded by five kids. The kids are actually friends of Henzo's that got lost in the mist over 50 years ago.
episodes.title: Residents of the Land of Eternity! The Pumpkin Pirates!

episodes.synopsis: Henzo, his friends, and the others try to find a way out of the ship graveyard. Meanwhile, the Mayor and his men let the information about the Rainbow Mist slip to the remaining Straw Hats still on Ruluka.
episodes.title: Thoughts of Home! The Pirate Graveyard of No Escape!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy accidentally propels himself and Rapanui to the end of the mist. Nami appears in the ship graveyard with a rowboat full of treasure and a string connected to the real world, which are both stolen by Wetton's subordinate. The Mayor uses the Rainbow Tower to make a bridge to the Rainbow Mist.
episodes.title: An Inevitable Melee! Wetton's Schemes and the Rainbow Tower!

episodes.synopsis: The Going Merry escapes from the Rainbow Mist, getting badly damaged on the way. The Mayor gets arrested by a bunch of powerful marines that turn out to be older versions of Henzo's friends, who were thrown 50 years into the past by the Rainbow Mist's collapse.
episodes.title: And so, the Legend Begins! To the Other Side of the Rainbow!

episodes.synopsis: Nami's log pose begins to point to the sky, and the crew finds a map of an island named 'Skypiea' on a 200-year-old ship. They compete with the monkey-like Masira's salvage crew while they search for more clues on how to get there.
episodes.title: The Log is Taken! Salvage King, Masira!

episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats decide to go to Jaya island to look for information on Skypeia. Meanwhile, Ace suddenly shows up on Buggy's ship; Buggy does not let any of his men attack Ace, fearing Whitebeard's retribution.
episodes.title: Monsters Appear! Don't Mess with the Whitebeard Pirates!

episodes.synopsis: Jaya's main town is full of famous pirates that are constantly brawling with each other. Luffy and Zoro have a run-in with a pirate known as 'Bellamy the Hyena,' who ridicules their dreams and beats them up.
episodes.title: Quit Dreaming! Mock Town, the Town of Ridicule!

episodes.synopsis: After refusing to fight Bellamy, Luffy, Zoro and Nami run into a certain cherry pie lover. They leave Mock Town, and get into a fight with Masira's brother Shoujou, another salvage monkey.
episodes.title: Distinguished Pirates! A Man Who Talks of Dreams and the King of Undersea Search!

episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats meet with Mont Blanc Cricket on another part of Jaya; Cricket is a descendant of Montblanc Noland, an infamous "liar" who told of a gold city on Jaya, and Cricket was outcast for looking for artifacts of the gold city. He may be the only person who knows how to get to Skypiea.
episodes.title: Legendary Family! Noland, the Liar!

episodes.synopsis: Cricket explains how the Straw Hats can ride a dangerous vertical current called the Knock-Up Stream to get to Skypeia. However, they first have to catch a southbird to point them toward the point where the stream will erupt from the ocean.
episodes.title: Steer for the Clouds! Capture the South Bird!

episodes.synopsis: While the Straw Hats are looking for a Southbird, Bellamy and his crew attack Cricket's house, and steal the gold artifacts he'd collected over the years from his salvage work. When the Straw Hats return and see what happened, Luffy decides to take a side trip back to Mock Town.
episodes.title: Dreams Don't Come True?! Bellamy Versus the Saruyama Alliance!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy takes out Bellamy with a single punch. Meanwhile, the world government heads are concerned over Whitebeard, Shanks, and Luffy. The marines try to decide who will replace Crocodile as a Shichibukai - one of Blackbeard's crew shows up uninvited and nominates his captain.
episodes.title: 100 Million Man! World's Greatest Power and Pirate Black Beard!

episodes.synopsis: The Going Merry is refitted by Masira and Shoujou to be more flight capable, and the Straw Hats catch a ride on the Knock-Up Stream for Skypeia.
episodes.title: Take to the Sky! Ride the Knockup Stream!

episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats arrive in an ocean above the clouds. Usopp almost falls out of the Going Merry but is saved at the last minute. The crew is also attacked by a mysterious looking warrior, but is saved by the Knight of the Sky. Finally, they arrive at the border which transports them to the upper realm, Skypiea.
episodes.title: Sail the White Sea! The Sky Knight and the Gate in the Clouds!

episodes.synopsis: As the crew arrives in Skypiea, they are greeted by Conis and her pet Su. Both she and her father start explaining how the life in Skypiea is and how the different Dials work.
episodes.title: Godland, Skypiea! Angels on a Beach of Clouds!

episodes.synopsis: Nami finds out what should happen to anyone who enters the forest. Meanwhile, the rest of the gang are waiting for the wind to change but are rudely assaulted by Skypiea's police who are going to carry out Heaven's Judgement.
episodes.title: The Forbidden Sacred Ground! The Island Where God Lives and Heaven's Judgement!

episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats have some problems with the local justice enforcer force called "The White Berets."
episodes.title: Already Criminals?! Skypiea's Upholder of the Law!

episodes.synopsis: While trying to escape from Sky Island, Robin, Chopper, Nami and Zoro are held hostages by God Enel.
episodes.title: Is Escape Possible?!? God's Challenge is Set in Motion

episodes.synopsis: Conis leads Luffy, Usopp, and Sanji to a boat to get to Upper Yard, but she tells them it is a trap and almost gets hit by "Heaven's Judgment".
episodes.title: A Trap on Lovely Street! The Almighty Eneru

episodes.synopsis: Luffy, Usopp and Sanji finally enter Upper Yard, only to find out that the whole road is trapped heavily, but at last they arrive at the Ordeal Gates. Meanwhile Robin, Zoro, and Nami go out to explore Upper Yard while Chopper stays behind to guard the ship.
episodes.title: Onward Little Crow! To the Sacrificial Altar!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy, Sanji, and Usopp enter the Ordeal of Balls gate and encounter the Priest Satori.
episodes.title: 10% Survival Rate! Satori, the Mantra Master!

episodes.synopsis: Usopp, Sanji and Luffy fight Satori, but the power of Mantra seems to be too strong.
episodes.title: The Ordeal of Spheres! Desperate Struggle in the Lost Forest!

episodes.synopsis: Chopper, threatened by priest Shura, blows the whistle for Gan Fall to come, but before he can arrive, Priest Shura assaults Chopper and begins destroying the Going Merry.
episodes.title: Chopper in Danger! Former God vs. Priest Shura!

episodes.synopsis: Gan Fall cannot handle Shura and lost the battle. Meanwhile, Satori is finally defeated by Luffy and Sanji.
episodes.title: Profound Mystery! Ordeal of String and Ordeal of Love?!?

episodes.synopsis: Chopper is saved by a bunch of giant Southbirds, who tell him that Gan Fall was actually God. Nami, Zoro and Robin discover the reason why Upper Yard is a soil island: It was once part of Jaya, and this is the part that Liar Noland saw. Meanwhile the Shandia attack Upper Yard.
episodes.title: Light the Fire of Shandora! Wyper the Warrior!

episodes.synopsis: The Shandia attack on Upper Yard has started. The crew is finally reunited, and everyone speaks up about what has happened. Chopper takes care of Gan Fall, and the pirates plan to steal the gold on the island.
episodes.title: Jaya, City of Gold in the Sky! Head for God's Shrine!

episodes.synopsis: After befriending a wolf pack, Gan Fall tells the crew a little more about the history of Upper Yard.
episodes.title: Festival on the Night Before Gold-Hunting! Feelings for "Vearth!"

episodes.synopsis: Enel takes away the limitations of the priests. Also, Usopp witnesses a mysterious person fixing the ship; the next day Merry is found to be back to her original form. After getting her off the altar, the pirates plan out their course of action.
episodes.title: Enter God Eneru! Farewell to the Survivors!

episodes.synopsis: A giant python makes Luffy, Robin, Chopper and Zoro split while going to the ruins at the south.
episodes.title: A Giant Snake Bares Its Fangs! The Survival Game Begins!

episodes.synopsis: Wyper takes out Shura and tells his goal to the Shandia, and Enel speaks up about how many people will be alive by the end of his plan.
episodes.title: The Deadly Reject! War Demon Wyper's Resolve!

episodes.synopsis: Zoro fights the Shandia warrior Braham, and defeats him with Ittoryu (one sword style) 36 Pound Cannon technique.
episodes.title: Fierce Mid-Air Battle! Pirate Zoro vs. Warrior Braham!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy fights Wyper, but after some time, he falls into some underground ruins. Meanwhile, Enel appears on the Going Merry and after telling that his true goal was the City of Gold, he takes out both Usopp and Sanji; then he vanishes and leaves Satori's brothers: Hotori and Kotori to avenge him.
episodes.title: The Roaring Burn Bazooka!! Pirate Luffy vs. War Demon Wyper!

episodes.synopsis: Chopper is attacked by Gedatsu, who turns out to be a complete moron, and eventually defeats him, sending him plummeting to the Blue Sea. Conis and Pagaya help Aisa, and head to Upper Yard.
episodes.title: The Ordeal of Swamp! Chopper vs Priest Gedatsu!

episodes.synopsis: Enel defeats several members of the Shandia Tribe. Meanwhile, Gan Fall and Nami start and finish their fight with Kotori and Hotori. Hotori is defeated by Nami while Kotori is defeated by Gan Fall.
episodes.title: Unbeatable Powers! Eneru's True Form is Revealed!

episodes.synopsis: While Robin is looking at some ruins she found, Yama, The Chief Enforcer, attacks her. Yama is easily defeated by Robin. Later, she discovers the legendary city, Shandora.
episodes.title: A Mystical City! The Grand Ruins of Shandora!

episodes.synopsis: Priest Ohm appears and starts fighting everyone.
episodes.title: 0% Survival Rate! Chopper vs. Ohm, the Sword Wielding Priest!

episodes.synopsis: At the Upper Ruins, the fight between Ohm, Zoro, Gan Fall and Wyper begins. When Nami appears, she is swallowed by the giant python, along with Gan Fall and Aisa.
episodes.title: Climb Giant Jack! Deadly Combat in the Upper Ruins!

episodes.synopsis: Ohm makes matters worse, creating a barbed wire cage around the area. Laki is knocked out by Enel, and Nami, Aisa, and Gan Fall find out why the python was rampaging so much.
episodes.title: The Ordeal of Iron! White Barbed Death Match!

episodes.synopsis: Zoro finally defeats Priest Ohm with his 108 Pound Cannon technique. Meanwhile Pagaya and Conis hear the terrible truth about the goal of Enel: to eradicate every person in the sky.
episodes.title: Bursting Slash! Zoro vs Ohm!

episodes.synopsis: Enel appears only to reduce the group as close to his prediction as he can.
episodes.title: Collapsing Upper Ruins! The Quintet for the Finale!

episodes.synopsis: Enel counterattacks Gan Fall and lands a finishing hit. He then knocks out Robin as she tries to manipulate him. Zoro impresses Enel with his power but is easily beaten, while trying to make him pay for what he did to Robin; but it takes Wyper with a secret weapon to take Enel down.
episodes.title: Showdown in the Ancient Ruins! Sky God Eneru's Goal!

episodes.synopsis: Enel defeats Zoro and Wyper. Upon seeing this, Nami follows him to a cave where his ark, Maxim, is. Luffy finally gets out of the snake, along with Aisa, only to find out the outcome of the fight against Enel. When Aisa tells him that she knows where he is, he asks her to take him there.
episodes.title: Ambition Towards the Endless Vearth! The Ark Maxim!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy and Enel start fighting. Conis tells the dangers of staying in Sky Island to the other Skypieans.
episodes.title: They Finally Clash! Pirate Luffy vs God Eneru!

episodes.synopsis: The fight between Enel and Luffy continues with Enel starting a machine that would bring the death of Skypiea: Deathpiea.
episodes.title: Maxim Surfaces! Deathpiea is Activated!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy falls from the ark. Nami starts fighting Enel while Sanji and Usopp try to rescue her.
episodes.title: Luffy Falls! Eneru's Judgement and Nami's Wish!

episodes.synopsis: Usopp and Sanji split up to rescue Nami, but the first one to get on deck is Usopp.
episodes.title: The Two Awaken! On the Front Lines of the Burning Love Rescue!

episodes.synopsis: Enel's thunderclouds are coming down to Sky Island while the evacuation is half complete.
episodes.title: Capriccio for Despair! The Impending Doom of Sky Island!

episodes.synopsis: The history of Noland and Kalgara is told, as a flashback from Wyper.
episodes.title: Lead by a Bell's Sound! Tale of the Great Warrior and the Explorer!

episodes.synopsis: Noland and Kalgara are enjoying themselves, as well as the villagers and Noland's crew, but that changes one day, as the villagers start hating their new friends.
episodes.title: Free From the Spell! The Great Warrior Sheads Tears!

episodes.synopsis: The cause of the hatred is discovered and explained. Meanwhile, Kalgara vows to meet Noland again.
episodes.title: Eternal Friends! The Vowed Bell Echoes Across the Mighty Seas!

episodes.synopsis: Angel Island is destroyed by Enel's attacks. Luffy decides to go and ring the golden bell before Enel takes it away.
episodes.title: Angel Island, Obliterated! The Horror of The Raigo's Advent!!

episodes.synopsis: Nami finds out a way to get to Enel, by cutting down Giant Jack. Wyper finds out from Robin that Noland has a descendant that is searching for the Gold City, and that's the reason why Luffy wants to ring the Golden Bell.
episodes.title: Knock Over Giant Jack! Last Hope for Escape!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy battles Enel. Battle for Skypiea!
episodes.title: Miracle on Skypiea! The Love Song Heard in the Clouds!

episodes.synopsis: The 400 year war on Sky Island comes to an end. Montblanc Cricket and the Masira Brothers hear the Golden Bell ringing and realize that the Gold City was always in the sky. Enel, who was thrown to the Blue Sea heads out to the Fairy Vearth (the Moon). The Sky People (both Skypieans and Shandia) celebrate the end of the war with a great bonfire.
episodes.title: The Battle Ends! Proud Fantasia Echoes Far!

episodes.synopsis: Robin deciphers the poneglyphs on the Golden Bell and realizes how to find the Rio Poneglyph. She also discovers that the poneglyphs on the Bell were written by Gol D. Roger, who could understand poneglyphs, who had discovered the Rio Poneglyph, and had once visited Skypiea. Soon afterwards, the Straw Hats steal a bunch of gold from the Giant Anaconda's belly and they begin to leave Skypiea.
episodes.title: I Made it here! The Yarn the Poneglyphs Spin!

episodes.synopsis: The Golden Bell rings as the Straw Hats are going down to the sea, meaning that they are welcome and are deeply thankful for what they did. When the ship finally rests on the sea, problems appear, as the ship has landed in a Marine base.
episodes.title: Off to the Blue Sea!! A Heartfelt Finale!!

episodes.synopsis: The Marines are convinced the Going Merry is a ghost ship after it  crashes inside their fortress from above. The crew members are scattered  around the premises.
episodes.title: A State of Emergency is Issued! A Notorious Pirate Ship has Infiltrated!

episodes.synopsis: In disguise, Sanji shows the Marine chefs the proper way to prepare a meal.
episodes.title: Sanji the Cook! Proving His Merit at the Marine Dining Hall!

episodes.synopsis: Zoro is taken prisoner as Chopper and Nami assist a nervous doctor in treating injured Marines.
episodes.title: Captured Zoro! Chopper's Emergency Operations!

episodes.synopsis: Robin and Usopp both disguise themselves as the same visiting inspector,  and Usopp is thrown in the brig with Zoro. Luffy and Sanji are  discovered by Jonathan after a slight mishap.
episodes.title: The Marines Dragnet Closes In! The Second Member Captured!

episodes.synopsis: The real Inspector is thrown in the brig with Zoro and Usopp, while  Sanji and Luffy race to rescue the two while avoiding detection.
episodes.title: Luffy and Sanji's Daring Rescue Mission!

episodes.synopsis: Sanji and Luffy, after freeing Usopp and Zoro, try to escape Navarone.  As the Burning Soul combat unit is deployed, Dr. Kobato leads Nami and  Chopper to the docks.
episodes.title: Enter the Hot-Blooded Special Forces! Battle on the Bridge!

episodes.synopsis: The crew meets at the docks and are surrounded by Marines. Using Nami as their fake hostage, they trick the Marines into letting them back on the Going Merry.
episodes.title: Breaking Through the Seige! The Going Merry is Recovered!

episodes.synopsis: The crew disguises the Going Merry as a Marine ship so they can get their treasure back. With the gold, they decide they’ll hire a shipwright.
episodes.title: The Pirate Ship Disappears! Fortress Battle, Round #2!

episodes.synopsis: Usopp splits up the crew into two teams: the gold retrieval team and the waver retrieval team. Inspector Shepherd decides to catch Luffy on his own.
episodes.title: The Gold and Waver Recovery Operations!

episodes.synopsis: Sanji, Zoro, Usopp, and Robin continue to search for their treasure. Luffy leads Nami to the captain’s quarters where they retrieve their gold.
episodes.title: The One Fell Swoop Plan! Jonathan's Surefire Secret Tactic!

episodes.synopsis: The Going Merry is grounded during a period of low tide and Jonathan believes they’ve reached “checkmate”. They cleverly use the impact dial to boost the ship and the breath and flame dials to inflate the octopus balloon again so they can escape.
episodes.title: Farewell, Marine Fortress! The Last Battle for Escape!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy and company come across a mysterious pirate ship after trying to escape a giant wave. Soon, they arrive on an island inhabited by strange animals. Going Merry is captured by the Foxy Pirate crew.
episodes.title: Great Adventure at Long Ring Long Land!

episodes.synopsis: After Tonjit re-unites with his horse, they are soon attacked by Captain Foxy and his subordinates, who challenge Luffy in a Davy Back Fight, a contest of pirates where the stakes are members of the crew.
episodes.title: A Davy Back with the Foxy Pirates!

episodes.synopsis: The first round of Davy Back Fight involves a race around the island with tiny boats. Zoro's and Chopper's boat is eliminated.
episodes.title: Round 1! One Lap of the Donut Race!

episodes.synopsis: With only Luffy, Nami, and Porche's boat remaining, it's an all out war to the goal, but after Foxy exposes his Devil Fruit powers, Porche wins and takes Tony Tony Chopper from Luffy. The second round prepares to start.
episodes.title: Silver Fox Foxy! The Merciless Interference!

episodes.synopsis: Without Chopper, Sanji and Zoro must face the Foxy Pirates in a ball game, but are hampered by their blatant cheating and the crooked referee.
episodes.title: Round 2! Shoot it into the Groggy Ring!

episodes.synopsis: The bickering rivals Sanji and Zoro manage to overcome the opposing team by working together. Luffy chooses Tonjit's horse, Shelly over Chopper.
episodes.title: A Barrage of Red Cards in Groggy Ring!

episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats face Foxy a race around a giant ring on roller skates.
episodes.title: Round 3! The Round-and-Round Roller Race!

episodes.synopsis: Thanks to to some quick planning, the Straw Hats win the race.
episodes.title: A Seriously Heated Race! Into The Final Round!

episodes.synopsis: With Luffy's victory, he takes Chopper back, but foolishly accepts another challenge by Foxy.
episodes.title: Screaming-Hot Bombardment! Pirate Dodgeball!

episodes.synopsis: Foxy decides to take Robin from Luffy this time because of her Devil Fruit ability. The next match is a race to the top of the island.
episodes.title: Showdown on the Cliff! Red Light, Green Light!

episodes.synopsis: With Chopper gone again from Luffy's crew, Luffy and Foxy face off in the final game: a battle of brawn aboard Foxy's ship.
episodes.title: The Captains Square Off! The Final Combat Round!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy continues to battle Foxy with the odds not in his favor, and the fight continues inside Foxy's ship.
episodes.title: Full-Blast Slow-Slow Onslaught Vs. Invulnerable Luffy!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy manages to finally defeat Foxy by using his ability against him. After dismissing his new crewmembers, the Straw Hats leave in search for a shipwright.
episodes.title: Epic, Heated Combat! The Fateful Final Conclusion!

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious figure appears during the night and steals the memories of the crew. In the morning, Robin is the only one who remembers the Straw Hats adventures together. Her attempts to keep the crew together fail as Nami and Zoro go separate ways.
episodes.title: Was It Lost? Stolen? Who Are You?

episodes.synopsis: Robin suggests that only those who were sleeping lost their memories. Luffy and the others then remember seeing the mysterious boy who played some kind of flute. Later that night, they discover the boy outside and Luffy tries to fight him. At the last second, he proclaims his memory has returned.
episodes.title: A Mysterious Boy with a Horn and Robin's Deduction!

episodes.synopsis: During the night, Usopp, Chopper, and Sanji question what brought them to the Going Merry. In the morning, Usopp builds them a raft and they sail to the island where they meet Nami again. Meanwhile, the boy sets his sights on Zoro.
episodes.title: Now, Let's Get Back Our Memories! The Pirate Crew Lands on the Island!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to "The Palace of the Sea God" Robin's group meets an entranced Zoro. It looks like Zoro wants to fight so Luffy urges the others to keep going without him. They apprehend the kid but the whistle was what was really stealing their memories. Zoro returns, still entranced, but Luffy's nowhere to be seen.
episodes.title: Zoro Bares His Fangs! A Savage Animal Stands in the Way!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy returns and knocks some sense into Zoro. Cornered, the sea horse spreads illusions of the people in their memories to distract them. It steals their complete memories and claims that it has become a Sennenryu. Luffy defeats it and returns all the memories but the townspeople are convinced they are the memory stealers.
episodes.title: The Last Counterattack by the Memory Thief Who Reveals His True Colors!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy rescues Foxy, Hamburg, and Porche from a storm at sea. When they reunite with the Sexy Foxy ship, they find it captained by somebody new. Foxy accepts a Davy Back Fight in order to regain his ship and crew. Donning the afro once again, Luffy vows to defeat the captain.
episodes.title: Proud Man! Silver Fox Foxy!

episodes.synopsis: Once Foxy wins back his crew, he captures the Straw Hats. Nami and Luffy fight Foxy and although he's defeated, his crew accepts him back. Later, they sail to an island where they meet someone Robin knows: a Marine named Aokiji.
episodes.title: The Guy Who's The Closest To Invincible? And the Most Dangerous Man!

episodes.synopsis: The man they met, Marine High Admiral Aokiji, appears to be incredibly lazy. He first displays his Devil's Fruit ability by freezing the sea so some deserted people can get off the island. Unfortunately, he's determined to catch Robin. Luffy, Sanji, and Zoro attack but they seem to be no match.
episodes.title: Marine Headquarters Admiral Aokiji! The Ferocity of an Ultimate Powerhouse!

episodes.synopsis: Robin is frozen by Aokiji and Luffy tells the others to escape with her. In the Going Merry, Usopp and Chopper try to thaw her in the shower. Luffy gets defeated (frozen), but his life is spared as Aokiji believes he must repay the debt the marines incurred from Crocodile's defeat at Luffy's hands. With the crew defrosted, they continue sailing as usual. Zoro spots the giant frog they heard about and they chase it to an island with a lighthouse, but it appears they'll sink before they get there.
episodes.title: Duel Between Rubber and Ice! Luffy vs. Aokiji!

episodes.synopsis: After the Going Merry narrowly escapes being hit by a "sea train", the crew meets an old woman, Kokoro, and her granddaughter, Chimney. Kokoro gives Luffy a map to Water Seven. Luffy, Nami, and Usopp buy boats driven by sea monsters called "yagara".
episodes.title: The Dashing Sea Train and the City of Water: Water Seven!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy, Nami, and Usopp get strange greetings from the residents and they get to experience the roller coaster-like channels of Water Seven. Luffy find out that some pirates had been beaten at the hands of some powerful craftsmen; the Galley La Company. Chopper loses Robin and some strange new people threaten Zoro back on the ship.
episodes.title: Adventure in the City On the Water! Head to the Mammoth Shipbuilding Plant!

episodes.synopsis: The people who attacked Zoro reveal themselves to be the feared "Franky Family", though they're no match for Zoro. Luffy have their gold exchanged for cash. After, they meet a man who resembles Usopp, Galley La's carpenter employment foreman, Kaku. Usopp's cut of the money is stolen by the Franky Family.
episodes.title: The Franky Family and Iceberg!

episodes.synopsis: Paulie makes his debut when he retrieves Usopp's stolen money as he runs from debt collectors. Kalifa shows Luffy, Nami, and Usopp around Dock No. 1 and tells them how Iceburg founded the Galley La Company. Kaku returns from the Going Merry and tells them that their keel is irreparably damaged.
episodes.title: Galley-La Company! A Grand Sight: Dock #1!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy refuses to believe that Galley La cannot repair the Going Merry. The two soon realize that not only is Usopp missing now, but the two brief cases that were returned to them are empty. Nami decides to head to Franky House and finds Usopp on the way in a pitiful state. As she heads back to the ship for help, Usopp goes to the Franky House himself.
episodes.title: Pirate Abduction Incident! A Pirate Ship That Can Only Await Her End!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy, Sanji, Zoro, and Chopper follow Usopp's bloody trail to the Franky House, where they find him passed out in front. The four of them challenge the Franky Family only to find out that their real target, Franky himself, is gone and has taken the money with him.
episodes.title: Rescuing Our Friend! Raid on the Franky House!

episodes.synopsis: Once they're back on the ship, Luffy has to finally tell Usopp that the Going Merry can no longer be repaired and that they've chosen to get a new ship without him. Usopp believes that Luffy has abandoned the dignity of their ship and says he's leaving the crew. That night, he challenges Luffy to a duel.
episodes.title: Big Fight under the Moon! The Pirate Flag Flutters with Sorrow!

episodes.synopsis: Usopp fights Luffy in order to decide who keeps the Going Merry; he fights harder than he's ever fought before. Luffy actually seems to pose no threat but all the while, he's remembering what great friends they used to be, sailing together on the same ship. Even after taking a harsh beating, Luffy defeats Usopp. They leave Usopp and the ship behind.
episodes.title: Luffy vs. Usopp! Collision of Two Men's Pride!

episodes.synopsis: The Strawhats get themselves a hotel room. Nami finds the crew on the roof with urgent news: Iceburg has been shot. As the Galley La Company frantically search for answers, Nami and Luffy decide to check on his condition – only to be met by closed gates. Franky appears then to exact his revenge – with style.
episodes.title: Severe Shock Hits the City of Water! Iceberg Targeted!

episodes.synopsis: In the streets outside of the hospital, Luffy fights Franky. Inside, Iceburg recalls seeing Nico Robin and another tall man before he was shot. The Galley La company run outside and stop Franky and Luffy and tell them that they suspect the Strawhat Pirates of the crime.
episodes.title: Gum-Gum Human Vs. Fire-Breathing Cyborg!

episodes.synopsis: The Galley La Company continues to fight Luffy and Franky is enraged that they've stolen his opponent. An incredibly high tide called the "Aqua Laguna" is coming and Chopper and Sanji rush to warn Usopp. Luffy raises some chaos in order to meet with Iceburg and he demands to know what's happening. Iceburg says he wants to see Robin one more time.
episodes.title: The Straw Hat Pirates are the Culprits? The Protectors of the City of Water!

episodes.synopsis: In a bar, Franky talks with Kokoro about her theory on who shot Iceburg. The rumors she speaks of seem to have some truth as we see Robin meeting with someone from an organization called CP9. While the crew hide from angry residents, Sanji and Chopper discover Robin and she tells them what they've feared: she's responsible and she wants to part ways.
episodes.title: Eternal Farewell? Nico Robin, the Woman Who Draws Darkness!

episodes.synopsis: Chopper reunites with the others without Sanji and they discuss what's happened. Luffy decides that in order to know the full truth, they must catch Robin. Usopp attempts to repair the ship enough to withstand the Aqua Laguna and the Strawhats make their way to the Galley La Company.
episodes.title: Capture Robin! The Determination of the Straw Hats!

episodes.synopsis: The Strawhats (still missing Sanji) rush to Galley La where Robin and CP9 begin a raid. In Iceburg's room, Robin and the mysterious man Iceburg saw before, tell him that they've purposely placed the blame on the pirates. Their true aim is the blueprints he would've passed down to Paulie. Luffy separates from his group.
episodes.title: Cannon Fire Is the Signal! CP9 Goes Into Action!

episodes.synopsis: Robin speaks with Iceburg inside his room still. We already know that Robin can read the poneglyphs - and it seems Iceburg is the one with the blueprints to the ultimate weapon, Pluton. The true enemies are revealed to be Iceburg's own allies. Elsewhere, Luffy is tied up with Paulie after Paulie tells members of CP9 that his blueprints are fake.
episodes.title: CP9 Takes Off Their Masks! Their Shocking True Faces!

episodes.synopsis: Lucci tells Iceburg their hypothesis and has Kaku check his pulse to tell if the things he tells him are true. They suspect that Iceburg's friend from the past, Cutty Flam, is really Franky and it's revealed to be true. Therefore, Franky has the real blueprints. The Strawhat Pirates and Paulie break into the room where they find Iceburg and CP9.
episodes.title: Secret Bond! Iceberg and Franky!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy and the others request that Robin comes back to the crew. She refuses and tells them that she cannot accomplish her "wish" if she were to stay with them. Robin turns to leave and CP9 try to hold the pirates back. Robin successfully escapes and Lucci shows those remaining his "transformation".
episodes.title: Come Back, Robin! Showdown with CP9!

episodes.synopsis: Lucci's transformation is a result of a Devil's Fruit; a Zoan Type leopard. He quickly disposes of the crew and CP9 tie up Paulie and Iceburg, leaving them alone as the building slowly burns down around them. In Franky's underground hideout, Usopp tells him his story and Franky is finally touched. In return, Franky tells him a little about Tom's contributions to Water Seven.
episodes.title: The Straw Hat Pirates Annihilated? The Menace of the Leopard Model!

episodes.synopsis: Usopp believes that the person who repaired the Going Merry in Skypeia was really the Going Merry itself. Franky says that the ship was inhabited by a spirit who enters ships who are dearly cared for. The spirit repaired their ship just enough for them to reach the next island. The doorbell rings from the sea side and the Galley La foremen enter.
episodes.title: The Man Who Is Loved Even by His Ship! Usopp's Tears!

episodes.synopsis: The foremen discover Franky's hidden room and he fears they'll trample his memories. A long flashback ensues, covering Franky's past in Tom's Workers and how he and Iceburg helped create the Sea Train.
episodes.title: Franky's Past! The Day the Sea Train First Ran!

episodes.synopsis: Spandam, a CP5 representative, was determined to get Tom proven guilty in his trial so he could get the blueprints. As Franky walked into the town, people from the government began to attack with the battleships he had personally constructed. Tom and Iceburg run to their shipyard where they're attacked by two ships which also destroy the others. Iceburg tells Franky that he has to take responsibility or he'll never forgive him.
episodes.title: Spandam's Scheme! The Day the Sea Train Shook!

episodes.synopsis: Franky said that if a ship of his were to be used as a weapon, then it's no longer one of his ships. That enraged Tom and he punched Franky for the first time, telling him he had to take pride in the ships he created. He then told the judge that he would accept the punishment for both his previous crime and the recent attack. Franky tried to stop the train to Enies Lobby with his bare hands.
episodes.title: The End of the Legendary Man! The Day the Sea Train Cried!

episodes.synopsis: Chopper escapes the burning building with Paulie and Iceburg on his back and collapses outside. Iceburg tells Nami that CP9 threatened to destroy the Straw Hats if Robin didn't cooperate with them. Nami rushes to tell Chopper so they can go looking for the rest of the crew. Elsewhere, the foremen let go of the Going Merry so she would be destroyed at sea.
episodes.title: The Truth Behind Her Betrayal! Robin’s Sorrowful Decision!

episodes.synopsis: Paulie helps clear the name of the Strawhats but doesn't tell the mob everything he knows. He gets the mob to follow Chopper so they can search for the rest of the crew. Nami goes her own way so she can rush to the Sea Train. As Nami nears the station, Sanji, ahead of her, approaches the train
episodes.title: The Steam Whistle Forces Friends Apart! The Sea Train Starts to Run!

episodes.synopsis: Nami and the conductors are rescued by Paulie when the Aqua Laguna floods the main station. A man hands Nami a letter he found from Sanji. It informs her that Usopp, Franky, and he are on board the train that had just departed. On board, he storms the cars. High up in the city, Nami speaks with Kokoro and spots Luffy, stuck in between two buildings, in the back streets where the Aqua Laguna will hit first.
episodes.title: Sanji Barges In! Sea Train Battle in the Storm!

episodes.synopsis: Nami finally reaches Luffy and tells him that he needs to hurry before Robin reaches Enies Lobby. Chopper finds Zoro and hands him the Sandai Kitetsu so he can escape the chimney. Luffy pushes apart the buildings he was stuck between and Paulie grabs them all so they can escape the Aqua Laguna's massive wave.
episodes.title: Nami's Soul Cries Out! Straw Hat Luffy Makes a Comeback!

episodes.synopsis: Sanji fights his way through another train car and finds Usopp and Franky. Seeing how determined Luffy is to save Robin, Kokoro and Iceburg lends the Strawhat crew the use of another sea train, Rocket Man. The Franky Family shows up, pleading with Luffy to let them join them because they'll do anything for their leader.
episodes.title: Another Sea Train? Rocketman Charges Forth!

episodes.synopsis: The Rocket Man finally makes it out to sea. As the train connects with the tracks, Luffy has to rescue Chimney before she's thrown off by the wind. In the meanwhile, Iceburg has a flashback about when he finally met Franky again in Water Seven. With Luffy and Chimney safe in the train, Paulie tells his fellow carpenters who the real culprits were. The Strawhats, Franky Family, and Galley La Company form an alliance.
episodes.title: Rescue Our Friends! A Bond Among Foes Sworn with Fists!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy and Zoro perform a move that acts similar to a cannon and blasts a hole through the wall of the tidal wave ahead of them, opening up a channel for them to pass through. They miraculously pass through unscathed and the passengers rejoice. Sanji contacts the rest of the crew and fills them in on his current situation. Usopp separates from them but later, when Sanji and Franky are spotted, a man named Sogeking comes to their rescue.
episodes.title: Smash the Wave! Luffy and Zoro Use the Strongest Combo!

episodes.synopsis: Sogeking makes his grand entrance. Franky and Sanji aren't fooled by his costume but they try to humor him. They devise a plan first, then detach the last two cars and fight their way through the rest. Back in the Rocket Man, Luffy, Zoro, Nami, and Chopper get an outfit change; Nami shows off the weapon Usopp upgraded for her while he was still with them.
episodes.title: A Mysterious Man Appears?! His Name Is Sogeking!

episodes.synopsis: Kalifa updates the CP9 on the situation with Franky, Sanji, and Usopp. Sanji tells Franky and Usopp to go on without him so he can fight Wanze and his "Ramen Kenpo". Franky begins to fight Nero, CP9's "Weasel", and Sogeking meets with Robin.
episodes.title: Showdown Between Cooks! Sanji vs. Ramen Kenpo

episodes.synopsis: Franky's fight with Nero continues. Nero discovers that Franky's weak spot is his back, so Franky lies down flat so he can't get to it. Nero demands that he fight seriously, so Franky gets up to perform his "Centaur" form. Sogeking talks with Robin and tells her that the crew knows about her reasons for leaving. Those on the Rocket Man encounter the discarded cars and Zoro slices them so they can pass.
episodes.title: Rooftop Duel! Franky vs. Nero

episodes.synopsis: Zoro clashes with "Ship Cutter" T-Bone. The fight is short and Zoro joins the crew again in the Rocket Man. On the Puffing Tom, Sanji beats Wanze beautiful, though Wanze thinks he's ruined his face. Franky finally gains the upper hand against Nero and defeats him. After beating their respective opponents, Franky and Sanji stand to fight against the other CP9.
episodes.title: Clash! Demon-Slasher Zoro vs. Ship-Slasher T-Bone!

episodes.synopsis: After hiding under Robin's cloak for a few episodes, Sogeking finally shows himself. They stumble into the room with the CP9 and meet with Sanji and Franky. Sogeking produces a smokescreen. The four head into another car, detach it, and escape. It's not long before Blueno pulls their car back, though. Franky knocks down the wall so they can escape but ends up on the enemy car. Blueno opens a door then back in the Strawhat car.
episodes.title: Scramble over Robin! A Cunning Plan by Sogeking!!

episodes.synopsis: Robin willingly follows Blueno into his improvised door and Sogeking and Sanji are left alone. For a while, Blueno explains a little of Robin's past involving the Buster Call. Back at the Rocket Man, Yokuzuna the frog jumps onto the front of the train, knocking them from the rails. After Kokoro speaks with him, he joins the group. The CP9, Franky, and Robin finally reach Enies Lobby and disembark.
episodes.title: The Judicial Island! Full View of Enies Lobby!

episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats hatch a plan to rescue Robin, but as usual, Luffy can't wait to find a fight. Will his impulsive attack derail their mission?
episodes.title: Landing Operations Start! Charge in, Straw Hats!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy manages to reach the main island, but the Franky Family's assault is stopped short by a couple of angry giants!
episodes.title: Luffy Cuts Through! Big Showdown on the Judicial Island!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy makes short work of a few hundred marines, the Franky Family takes down a giant, and the assassins of CP9 report back to Spandam!
episodes.title: Battle Against Giants! Open the Second Gate!

episodes.synopsis: Zoro's quick thinking - and a little help from a giant frog - sends the sea train soaring into the sky on a collision course with armed guards and their canine companions!
episodes.title: Find a Way Out! Rocketman Takes Flight!

episodes.synopsis: Nami electrocutes the enemy with a Clima Tact attack, but the bad guys have the Straw Hats surrounded until the Franky Family shows up with a couple of sea monsters!
episodes.title: Catch Up with Luffy! The Straw Hats' All-Out Battle

episodes.synopsis: Zoro, Sanji, Nami, and Chopper try to catch up with their captain, Soge King is nowhere to be found, and Luffy runs head first into a battle with Blueno!
episodes.title: Robin Betrayed! The Motive of the World Government!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy shows off his new strength in a brawl with Blueno, Soge King befriends a giant, and a hulking sea beast makes the ultimate sacrifice.
episodes.title: Give Robin Back! Luffy vs. Blueno!

episodes.synopsis: While Luffy continues his battle with Blueno, Soge King's giant companions make their presence felt, and the assassins of CP9 experiment with Devil Fruits!
episodes.title: Don’t Stop! Hoist the Counterattack Signal!

episodes.synopsis: A blind Kingbull fights with his last breath to get the Straw Hats one step closer to their captain. Luffy kick his body into second gear to protect his friends from dangerous foes!
episodes.title: Almost to Luffy! Gather at the Courthouse Plaza!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy batters a baffled Blueno with his powerful new fighting style, and the cowardly Spandam begins to panic at the sound of the Straw Hats approaching!
episodes.title: Everything Is to Protect My Friends! Second Gear Activated!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy and his crew are finally reunited and ready to rescue Robin, but the raven-haired beauty remains reluctant to rejoin her former mates despite Franky's urging.
episodes.title: Give Us Your Answer, Robin! The Straw Hats' Outcry!

episodes.synopsis: Flash back to Robin's days as a young girl, her dangerous pursuit of forbidden knowledge, and her encounter with a friendly giant.
episodes.title: Robin's Past! The Girl was Called a Devil!

episodes.synopsis: Robin's flashback continues with the heartbreaking arrival of her mother - and the government's cruel and brutal invasion of a peaceful island!
episodes.title: Fated Mother and Daughter! The Mother's Name is Olvia!
